import json
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
from harness import run

FAIL = []


def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print('FAIL %s\n  got  %s\n  want %s' % (name, json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True),
                                                json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)))
    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


def book(bid, owner, s, e, env):
    return {"id": bid, "owner": owner, "window": [s, e], "envelope": env}


over = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 3, "links": [[0, 1, 10]],
     "bookings": [book("a", "x", 0, 10, [[0, 6]]), book("b", "y", 0, 10, [[0, 6]])]},
]
out = run(over)
expect('overbooked load', out[0], {"status": "invalid"})

adjacent = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 3, "links": [[0, 1, 10]],
     "bookings": [book("a", "x", 0, 10, [[0, 6]]), book("b", "y", 10, 20, [[0, 6]])]},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [0, 10]},
]
out = run(adjacent)
expect('adjacent load', out[0], {"status": "ok", "rev": 0, "now": 0})
expect('adjacent audit', out[1], {"status": "ok", "rev": 0, "now": 0, "leases": ["a", "b"],
                                  "samples": [[0, [4]], [10, [4]]]})

partial = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 3, "links": [[0, 1, 10], [1, 2, 4]],
     "bookings": [book("a", "x", 0, 10, [[0, 10], [1, 4]])]},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [0]},
]
out = run(partial)
expect('full booking', out[0], {"status": "ok", "rev": 0, "now": 0})
expect('full audit', out[1], {"status": "ok", "rev": 0, "now": 0, "leases": ["a"],
                              "samples": [[0, [0, 0]]]})

print()
print('FAILURES: %d' % len(FAIL))
PYEOF
